validationNotes: supported cards must include non-empty local oracleText/rules text for UI readability
reference-only cards set supported=false and are rejected from playable decks

buildValidation: commander id resolves and is a legendary creature in the current trainer rules
deck colorIdentity exactly matches commander colorIdentity
every card id resolves in the card database
nonbasic cards appear at most once; repeated quantities are allowed only for basic lands
every card color identity is a subset of the commander color identity
playable decks contain no supported=false reference-only cards
deck contains exactly 100 cards including commander
cardCount, when present, equals the calculated total

pipeline.rule: Runtime imports only src/data/generated. Generated files are produced only from the authoritative src/data/source schema; Scryfall refresh may add descriptive metadata but never replaces local machine-readable rules fields.
